lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines traversing the torso mass. Spacing is tighter on the anterior shoulder and posterior rump, with wider gaps in the central ribcage area.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the 8th vertical line from the neck, splitting at approximately the lower third of the torso depth.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 10th and 11th lines from the neck exhibit dashed morphology and terminate before reaching the ventral boundary of the torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 7 high-contrast white spots is localized on the lower haunch, situated between the final vertical line and the tail attachment point.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A horizontal alignment of three distinct spots forms a semi-connected geometric line across the mid-thigh region of the hind limb.

other_distinctive_markers: A white chevron mark is present between the eyes, and two distinct white spots are located on the lateral muzzle. White banding is visible on the lower limbs above the hooves.
